verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers is squarely built for this story: docs, CLI (Wrangler), local simulator (Miniflare), multi-language/framework support, bindings to storage/DB, cron/queues/workflows, and rollbacks all show a complete no-server-management serverless deployment story, corroborated by multiple hands-on community reports of quick, easy production deployments. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks validating 'no cold starts' claims and some community friction around lock-in/runtime limits for long-running or Node-heavy apps.
